title: サマースプリントシリーズ制覇！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan conquers the Summer Sprint Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She receives an award from Director Akikawa, as well as the opportunity to get a picture with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While sharing her knowledge about taking cute pictures, the two discuss a promotion campaign for the school…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which is how Curren Chan cleverly lands herself a job as the campaign's face.
